functions.starts_operator:
int starts_operator(char c)
{
    switch (c)
    {
    case '-':
    case '+':
    case '*':
    case '/':
    case '=':
    case ':':
    case '%':
    case '&':
    case '|':
    case '<':
    case '>':
    case '!':
    case '~':
    case '^':
        return 1;
    default:
        return 0;
    }
}
